groups.definition: Emerging and conflicting AI regulations across jurisdictions raise compliance costs and may restrict AI-enabled products.
Changes in laws and regulations across jurisdictions increase compliance costs, restrict operations, or expose the company to enforcement actions and fines.
Customers impose stricter labor, materials, and environmental standards that raise costs and risk disqualification if the company or its suppliers cannot comply.
Evolving and divergent regulation of automated driving systems, including possible pre-approval requirements, increases compliance costs and may delay products.
